issues.detail: The Hebrew text says 'וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ יָרָבְעָם' (And it happened when Jeroboam heard), but the Vietnamese says 'Khi Rê-hô-bô-am con trai của Sa-lô-môn nghe tin' (When Rehoboam son of Solomon heard). The subject is swapped: the Hebrew has Jeroboam hearing, not Rehoboam. This changes who is doing the action.
